title: SAT Math Pilot — Illustrative Practice
description: Original, unofficial examples across all four SAT Math domains with MCQ and student-produced response.

questions.text: A positive number x satisfies x² = 49. Enter x.
questions.explanation: The positive solution to x squared equals 49 is 7.

questions.text: A $40 item is discounted by 15%. What is its sale price?
questions.explanation: Fifteen percent of $40 is $6; subtract the discount.

questions.text: A rectangle is 7 units long and 4 units wide. What is its area?
questions.explanation: Area is length multiplied by width: 7 × 4.
